what: Validator wiring expands beyond the issue-scoped consumers
scenario_or_breakage: Issue #3074 names skills/design/scripts/tally-plan-review.sh and scripts/dispatch-plan-voters.sh for --design-tmpdir hardening, but the SIMPLE plan sweeps many unrelated design helpers and docs, increasing diff size and regression surface without a stated correctness need.
suggested_fix: Limit the validator wiring in this pass to tally-plan-review.sh and dispatch-plan-voters.sh, plus their docs/tests; file or defer the broader all-consumer sweep unless the feature description is updated to require it.

what: Validator creates parents before proving the path is allowed
scenario_or_breakage: A disallowed missing-parent path can still create directories outside the allowlist before the validator rejects it, so the hardening still mutates unintended filesystem locations.
suggested_fix: Make validation side-effect-free until allowlist success: canonicalize an existing ancestor or require an allowed lexical prefix before mkdir, then create parents only after the resolved target is allowed; add a disallowed missing-parent no-create test.

what: Plan omits the required SECURITY.md update
scenario_or_breakage: The plan changes security-relevant behavior for design tmpdir path confinement and FD-3 newline injection resistance, but it does not list SECURITY.md despite the repo constraint.
suggested_fix: Add a minimal SECURITY.md update covering the new design tmpdir allowlist and emit_kv single-line value contract, or explicitly justify why the security policy does not need a change.
